title: Ground-Truth, Whose Truth? - Examining the Challenges with Annotating Toxic Text Datasets
reasoning: The paper's central theme is the subjective and ethical nature of defining 'truth' in the context of toxic speech. The title 'Ground-Truth, Whose Truth?' directly questions the objectivity of labels for morally-charged content. It investigates how annotator values, backgrounds, and diverse interpretations (which are tied to ethical frameworks) impact the creation of datasets used for content moderation, an inherently ethical task.
